title: RITE: Evaluating End-to-End Resilience to Silent Tool Errors in E-Commerce Agentic Systems
title_zh: RITE：评估电商智能体系统对静默工具错误的端到端韧性

paragraphs.en: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly answer e-commerce queries through multi-step tool interactions. The expected output of a tool call can shift between agent development and execution, allowing a plausible but incorrect value to be returned without an explicit failure signal. These silent errors may propagate through subsequent decisions into final answers. To study agents’ resilience across this end-to-end process, we formulate Silent-error Resilience Task, an interactive task that evaluates whether they complete the original query after a silent error corrupts an intermediate state. We introduce RITE, a benchmark built from human-authored industrial workflows and production-log-derived inputs. To enable controlled and reproducible evaluation, we use a semantic error taxonomy to inject errors into fixed workflow prefixes, freeze recorded tool behavior, and let agents continue freely. It contains 167 matched units across nine e-commerce workflows, yielding 501 silent-error, correct-value, and explicit-failure instances. Across 10 recent LLMs, silent errors roughly halve task success and are consistently harder than explicit failures. Recognition, use of an available verification path, and integration of the resulting evidence form successive bottlenecks. We also propose a light State Checker as an intervention to test whether resilience can be improved.

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLM systems increasingly complete e-commerce tasks through multi-step workflows that invoke multiple external tools and pass their outputs from one step to the next. In industrial deployments, a tool’s runtime output may differ from what the agent was built to expect because underlying business data, tool implementations, or deployed versions can change between development and execution. This build-time–runtime mismatch can remain hidden: a call may complete and conform to the expected API schema while returning a plausible value that is incorrect for the current task. We refer to such plausible-but-wrong intermediate values without an explicit failure signal as silent errors . For example, suppose a user mainly watches local football videos, one of which mentions blockchain-based fan tokens. During agent development, the profile tool returns “local sports”; after an update that overweights “blockchain,” it returns “blockchain” at execution. The new label remains plausible and schema-valid, so no failure is signaled. The absence of an explicit failure signal makes silent errors particularly severe: an agent may have no immediate basis for detecting that the value is incorrect. It may therefore propagate the corrupted value through subsequent tool calls, allowing a single intermediate error to directly alter the final user-facing output.

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks evaluate tool use in nominal settings ( Qin et al., 2024 ; Trivedi et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) , recovery from explicit or implicit faults injected while agents run ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , silent-error detection ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Mazumder and jahan Lia, 2026 ) , or how corrupted intermediate values affect later outputs ( Gurram, 2026 ) . In these fault-based settings, each agent runs freely and meets a fault only if and when its own trajectory reaches the perturbed call, so different agents face silent errors at different points and with different histories. They therefore cannot compare different agents on the same silent error at the same decision point, nor pair that error with correct-value and explicit-failure counterparts at that point.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准在标称设置下评估工具使用（Qin et al., 2024；Trivedi et al., 2024；Ma et al., 2024），评估智能体运行时注入的显性或隐性故障的恢复（Zhu et al., 2026；Tian et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026），评估静默错误检测（Sun et al., 2024；Mazumder and jahan Lia, 2026），或评估被破坏的中间值如何影响后续输出（Gurram, 2026）。 在这些基于故障的设置中，每个智能体自由运行，只有当且仅当其自身轨迹到达被扰动的调用时才会遇到故障，因此不同智能体在不同时间点、带着不同的历史面临静默错误。 因此，这些基准无法让不同智能体在同一个决策点上的同一个静默错误上进行比较，也无法在该点将此错误与正确值对应情形和显性失败对应情形配对。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we formulate Silent-error Resilience Task, in which a plausible but incorrect tool result enters an agent’s execution history without an explicit failure signal. Given the query and toolbox, the agent operates in an agentic loop, repeatedly reasoning, calling tools that may return silent errors, and incorporating their outputs until it produces a final answer. The task asks whether the agent can recognize the error, reacquire reliable evidence, and complete the original query instead of propagating the error into its final answer.
paragraphs.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们提出了静默错误韧性任务（Silent-error Resilience Task），在该任务中，一个看似合理但错误百出的工具结果会在没有显式失败信号的情况下进入智能体的执行历史。 给定查询和工具箱，智能体在智能体循环中运行，反复推理、调用可能返回静默错误的工具，并将它们的输出纳入其中，直到产生最终答案。 该任务检验的是智能体能否识别错误、重新获取可靠证据，并完成原始查询，而不是将错误传播到其最终答案中。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate this task under controlled conditions, we introduce RITE (Resilience to Incorrect Tool Evidence). Each human-authored workflow specifies a pre-orchestrated agentic process, and its execution log records tool calls and observations in the same format as an agent trajectory. We use this log as a fixed trajectory, allowing us to control where a silent error is introduced. We select a semantically important slot in the log and inject a silent error at that point. The trajectory up to and including this slot is provided as the agent’s prefix, while the workflow’s tools and their recorded input–output behavior are frozen to form the evaluation world, so that recorded calls return identical outputs across models and conditions. The agent then continues in an agentic loop, allowing us to compare its behavior while controlling for error type, slot, and environment.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在受控条件下评估该任务，我们提出了 RITE（对错误工具证据的韧性，Resilience to Incorrect Tool Evidence）。 每个人工编写的工作流都规定了一个预先编排的智能体过程，其执行日志以与智能体轨迹相同的格式记录工具调用和观察结果。 我们将该日志作为固定轨迹，从而可以控制在何处引入静默错误。 我们在日志中选择一个语义上重要的槽位，并在该位置注入一个静默错误。 该槽位及之前的轨迹将作为智能体的前缀，而工作流的工具及其记录的输入–输出行为则被冻结以构成评估环境，从而使记录的调用在不同模型和条件下返回完全相同的输出。 随后智能体在智能体循环中继续运行，使我们能够在控制错误类型、槽位和环境的前提下比较其行为。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 10 recent closed and open-weight LLMs on RITE. Across all models, silent errors reduce task success to roughly half of correct-condition performance and are consistently harder to handle than matched explicit failures. Our analysis traces this weakness through a three-stage chain: agents often fail to recognize that an inherited value may be wrong; recognition does not reliably lead them to refetch its source; and refetching does not guarantee that the corrected value is carried through to final recovery . We further find that most benchmark corruptions would change the downstream e-commerce task output, with damage varying substantially by error type and workflow position. Finally, a lightweight State Checker makes agents notice and refetch more often but yields only limited improvement in final task success. Making agents look is therefore easier than making them repair what they find. In summary, our contributions are:

paragraphs.en: Agent evaluation spans three levels. At the tool-call level, MetaTool ( Huang et al., 2024b ) asks whether a tool is needed and which one to select, while ToolBench, BFCL, and API-Bank ( Qin et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2023 ) evaluate call construction and extend to multi-tool, dependent, and stateful multi-turn interactions; ToolACE ( Liu et al., 2025 ) provides synthesized data for improving these abilities. At the task-outcome level, AppWorld, GAIA, and WebArena ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) judge a complete rollout by its final answer or by the state it leaves in the environment, while allowing different valid action paths. At the process level, AgentBoard ( Ma et al., 2024 ) tracks task progress, WorFBench ( Qiao et al., 2025 ) evaluates generated workflow structure, ToolScan ( Kokane et al., 2025 ) diagnoses call-level errors, and process-mining methods ( van der Aalst, 2016 ) compare executed and expected flows. Across these levels, the benchmarks above vary task difficulty and agent behavior but do not systematically manipulate the semantic correctness of intermediate tool values. We instead vary the intermediate business value and ask whether an agent can still complete the task correctly when that value is wrong. To keep the test controlled and reproducible, we provide the recorded workflow execution up to the selected checkpoint as the agent’s initial history, then let it continue freely.

paragraphs.en: Work on unreliable tools can be separated by the stage of the error-handling chain that it evaluates. One line studies recovery from tool failures: agents resume from the environment left by a failed attempt ( Tan et al., 2025 ) , rewind to an earlier checkpoint ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , recover from explicit or implicit faults injected into tool responses while the agent runs ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , or diagnose failed trajectories and characterize recovery cost ( Vuddanti and Chittiprolu, 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Resumption settings start from uncontrolled natural failures, while injection settings expose an agent to a fault only if and when its own trajectory reaches the perturbed call. A second line studies silent-error detection, asking whether agents identify faulty outputs that trigger no exception ( Sun et al., 2024 ) or silent data-quality faults introduced during controlled replay ( Mazumder and jahan Lia, 2026 ) . In both, the faulty response is delivered when the agent’s own run issues the corresponding call. A third line studies error propagation, tracing a schema-valid but semantically wrong argument to the final answer ( Gurram, 2026 ) and measuring how perturbed requests or tool responses alter later calls and task outcomes ( Xiong et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . To our knowledge, RITE is the first benchmark to evaluate business-semantic silent errors at controlled decision points: every agent encounters the same plausible but incorrect value after the same recorded execution history, the same point is also instantiated with the correct value and with an explicit failure, and the agent then continues freely to a final answer.

paragraphs.en: Work in this domain spans three forms of capability. Domain models test whether a model understands products and users well enough to answer questions ( Peng et al., 2024 ) , while recommender agents use that understanding to retrieve, rank, and recommend products ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024a ) . Shopping benchmarks place agents in interactive stores, where they must search, compare, and purchase while satisfying constraints on products, vouchers, budgets, and sellers ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Business-service benchmarks require agents to interact with users over multiple turns, operate on business records through tools, and comply with domain policies ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , while CRMArena-Pro additionally tests confidentiality in enterprise workflows ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . These benchmarks do not systematically test what happens when a task-critical business value is silently corrupted. Grounded in production execution logs and human-authored industrial e-commerce workflows, our benchmark instead examines this reliability risk involving tools developed and maintained by multiple parties: a call may complete while an intermediate business value is silently wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 该领域的工作涵盖三种形式的能力。 领域模型测试模型是否足够理解产品与用户从而回答问题（Peng et al., 2024），而推荐智能体则利用这种理解来检索、排序和推荐产品（Gao et al., 2023；Huang et al., 2024a）。 购物基准将智能体置于交互式商店中，它们必须在满足产品、优惠券、预算和卖家等约束条件的同时进行搜索、比较和购买（Yao et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2026a）。 业务服务基准要求智能体与用户进行多轮交互、通过工具操作业务记录，并遵守领域策略（Yao et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025），而 CRMArena-Pro 还额外测试企业工作流中的机密性（Huang et al., 2026）。 这些基准并未系统地测试当任务关键的业务值被静默破坏时会发生什么。 我们的基准基于生产执行日志和人工编写的工业电商工作流，转而考察这一涉及由多方开发和维护的工具的可靠性风险：一次调用可能顺利完成，而某个中间业务值却静默出错。

sents.zh: 购物基准将智能体置于交互式商店中，它们必须在满足产品、优惠券、预算和卖家等约束条件的同时进行搜索、比较和购买（Yao et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: Business-service benchmarks require agents to interact with users over multiple turns, operate on business records through tools, and comply with domain policies ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , while CRMArena-Pro additionally tests confidentiality in enterprise workflows ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 业务服务基准要求智能体与用户进行多轮交互、通过工具操作业务记录，并遵守领域策略（Yao et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025），而 CRMArena-Pro 还额外测试企业工作流中的机密性（Huang et al., 2026）。

sents.en: These benchmarks do not systematically test what happens when a task-critical business value is silently corrupted.
sents.zh: 这些基准并未系统地测试当任务关键的业务值被静默破坏时会发生什么。

sents.en: Grounded in production execution logs and human-authored industrial e-commerce workflows, our benchmark instead examines this reliability risk involving tools developed and maintained by multiple parties: a call may complete while an intermediate business value is silently wrong.
sents.zh: 我们的基准基于生产执行日志和人工编写的工业电商工作流，转而考察这一涉及由多方开发和维护的工具的可靠性风险：一次调用可能顺利完成，而某个中间业务值却静默出错。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark construction begins with two source collections. The first is the workflow collection 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , drawn from human-authored e-commerce workflows already deployed and running on an internal industrial workflow platform. We screen these existing workflows for structural validity and task diversity, yielding nine golden workflows with explicit control flow and deterministic tool dependencies. The second source is the input collection 𝒳 \mathcal{X} from a separate internal e-commerce data platform. Candidate production-log records are mapped to workflow inputs and selected only when their executions yield complete traces with task-relevant intervention points; the corresponding traces are retained. Appendix A defines the workflow- and log-selection criteria.

paragraphs.en: We constructed the silent-error taxonomy through a targeted, literature-grounded synthesis of adjacent error and failure taxonomies. We selected studies whose source categories could clarify the boundary of a silent state corruption or be operationalized as schema-valid, plausible-but-wrong workflow values. For each relevant source category, two authors independently assessed its observable error signal, workflow locus, and suitability for conversion into a single-slot implicit perturbation. They then reconciled overlapping categories and clarified the resulting boundaries. The final taxonomy contains seven leaf types organized into two semantic groups. Object or category selection errors cover substitution with a same-level category (category sibling drift), an ancestor or descendant (category granularity mismatch), or a similar but incorrect real entity (entity near-duplicate). Attribute or value errors cover changes to an entity’s attribute (profile attribute drift), movement to a neighboring valid numeric range (numeric bucket shift), superficially similar text with a different business meaning (semantic synonym drift), and reuse of a formerly valid but outdated value (temporal staleness). The benchmark instantiates every leaf type except temporal staleness. Although a stale value can be schema-valid and lead to an incorrect answer, recognizing that it is stale requires prior or time-indexed evidence that the agent does not observe. Appendix B provides the complete definitions, category boundaries, and literature grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过对相邻的错误与失败分类体系进行有针对性的、基于文献的综合，构建了静默错误分类体系。 我们选择那些源类别能够阐明静默状态损坏的边界，或能够被操作化为符合模式、貌似合理但错误的工作流取值的研究。 针对每个相关的源类别，两位作者独立评估其可观察的错误信号、工作流中的位置，以及将其转换为单槽隐式扰动的适用性。 随后，他们合并了重叠的类别，并澄清了由此产生的类别边界。 最终的分类体系包含七种叶子类型，组织为两个语义组。 对象或类别选择错误涵盖用同级类别进行替换（类别同级漂移）、用祖先或后代类别进行替换（类别粒度错配），以及用相似但不正确的真实实体进行替换（实体近似重复）。 属性或取值错误涵盖实体属性的改变（画像属性漂移）、移动到相邻的有效数值范围（数值桶偏移）、具有不同业务含义但表面相似的文本（语义同义漂移），以及重新使用曾经有效但已过时的取值（时间陈旧性）。 该基准实例化了除时间陈旧性之外的每一种叶子类型。 尽管陈旧的取值可以是符合模式的并导致错误答案，但识别其陈旧需要智能体无法观察到的先验或带时间索引的证据。 附录 B 提供了完整的定义、类别边界和文献依据。

paragraphs.en: The infrastructure has a shared start followed by two sibling construction branches:

paragraphs.en: The data branch constructs the paired prefixes initializing an agent, whereas the environment branch independently constructs the world where the agent continues acting (Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 数据分支构建用于初始化智能体的成对前缀，而环境分支则独立构建智能体在其中继续行动的世界（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: To avoid polluting the internal platform data, which may record the workflow execution result, we first post-process every selected workflow into a deployable replica by mocking out reporting and other side-effecting nodes and deploy the modified workflow back onto the platform. Then, a local central controller connects the log and workflow to provide an execution trace. It initially maps the production log record to the start schema of the deployed replica, producing the input x i x_{i} . It then invokes the deployed workflow through the platform API with x i x_{i} and retrieves the full execution trace of that run, which records every executed node with its arguments, outputs, status, and data dependencies. We retain only executions that complete successfully and contain full information needed to reconstruct the workflow state. The retained τ i \tau_{i} is therefore the clean execution record shared by the two downstream branches.
paragraphs.zh: 为避免污染可能记录工作流执行结果的内部平台数据，我们首先对每个选定的工作流进行后处理，通过模拟（mock）掉报告及其他具有副作用的节点，将其转换为可部署的副本，并把修改后的工作流重新部署回平台。 然后，一个本地中央控制器将日志与工作流连接起来，以提供执行轨迹。 它首先把生产日志记录映射到已部署副本的起始模式（schema），产生输入 x i x_{i}。 接着，它通过平台 API 以 x i x_{i} 调用已部署的工作流，并获取该次运行的完整执行轨迹，其中记录了每个被执行的节点及其参数、输出、状态和数据依赖关系。 我们只保留成功完成且包含重建工作流状态所需完整信息的执行。 因此，保留下来的 τ i \tau_{i} 就是供两个下游分支共同使用的干净执行记录。

paragraphs.en: Slot selection. We align the workflow graph with τ i \tau_{i} and obtain an execution graph whose edges carry the values propagated between nodes. We then search this graph along producer → s i → consumer → downstream result \text{producer}\rightarrow s_{i}\rightarrow\text{consumer}\rightarrow\text{downstream result} : an intermediate slot s i s_{i} qualifies when it carries business-relevant content, is consumed downstream, and plausibly affects the task outcome. paragraphs.en: Three conditions at the same slot. We truncate the common trace at the same slot and render the three prefixes p i correct p_{i}^{\mathrm{correct}} , p i explicit p_{i}^{\mathrm{explicit}} , and p i implicit p_{i}^{\mathrm{implicit}} (Sec. 3 ), with neutral historical rationales and no corruption marker. The correct condition preserves the recorded value. The explicit condition replaces access to that value with an overt failure, such as an empty argument or an error-bearing observation. The implicit condition obtains its value in two steps. First, it selects an applicable error type from the taxonomy and constructs a substitute that is type- and schema-compatible, remains locally plausible, and changes the task-relevant meaning of the slot. Depending on the error type and carrier, candidates come from compatible values observed in other cases or from a type-specific controlled transformation. Second, the selected substitute is written into the slot at its predetermined locus: the producer observation under tool_output , or a downstream tool argument under tool_input .

paragraphs.en: Verification. Before delivery, each candidate must preserve prefix executability and structural compatibility. Four additional gates then check the intervention itself. (1) Plausibility. The implicit value must remain schema-valid and locally reasonable while differing from the recorded value in task-relevant meaning. (2) Explicit-failure clarity. The explicit condition must expose an unambiguous failure signal. (3) Non-leakage. Neither the query nor the prefix may reveal that an intervention was applied. (4) Discriminability. The query remains solvable, and answers grounded in the gold value and in the polluted value must remain distinguishable under c i c_{i} . The surviving artifacts are delivered in the formulation’s schema D i k = ( q i , p i k , c i ) D_{i}^{k}=(q_{i},p_{i}^{k},c_{i}) , with all three conditions sharing the same query and result constraint. paragraphs.en: Across all ten models, implicit errors reduce RSR from 0.716–0.827 in the correct condition to 0.277–0.403, yielding Retention of only 0.345–0.526 (Table 1 ). This loss is tied to the absence of an observable failure signal: when the corresponding failure is explicit, RSR rises to 0.507–0.564, producing a positive explicit-minus-implicit paired gap for every model (+0.089 to +0.265; +0.214 pooled). Stronger task performance does not eliminate this vulnerability. Correct-condition RSR spans only 0.111 across models, whereas Retention spans 0.182; closed frontier models have higher mean Retention than open-weight models (0.517 versus 0.391), yet even the best model preserves barely half of its correct-condition performance. Thus, susceptibility to silent errors is widespread rather than confined to models with weak baseline task ability.

paragraphs.en: Across models, implicit-condition Noticed ranges only from 0.208 to 0.336 (Table 1 ), so most silent errors go unrecognized. Table 2 shows that recognition helps but is not sufficient: the latest producer observation matches the gold value in 0.3% of Unnoticed rollouts and 23.3% of Noticed rollouts, while 57.8% of Noticed rollouts still match the polluted value. Across the eight open-weight models, producer-refetch rate is positively but not significantly associated with Retention ( r = 0.491 r=0.491 , p = 0.217 p=0.217 ). paragraphs.en: To understand why refetching does not ensure recovery, we manually inspect the 60 trajectories that did not match value, focusing on unsolved rollouts in which the re-query nonetheless returns usable evidence. After usable evidence is acquired, we identify three recurring patterns. First, reasoning overwrite occurs when a model initially uses recovered evidence but later replaces it with a self-imposed heuristic. In one trajectory, an agent reconstructs the correct timestamps and uses them in the next RPC call, but then redefines the “opening warm-up” boundary and selects the wrong final comment. Second, lossy selection occurs when a model alters recovered candidates while choosing among them. One agent merges two recovered topic clusters despite an instruction to select one, while another replaces the retrieved topic with a plausible but unsupported reformulation. Third, unsupported synthesis occurs when a model uses corrected evidence but adds claims absent from it. Agents incorporate corrected profile or interest labels but add unsupported viewing-duration, interaction, or presentation claims. Across these patterns, usable evidence is obtained, but the correction does not carry through to the final answer.

paragraphs.en: We study silent errors in agentic tasks, where a plausible but incorrect tool result enters the execution history without an explicit failure signal and propagates through subsequent steps. We formulate a task that measures whether an agent can tolerate this corrupted state and still complete the original task, and introduce RITE, a benchmark built from 167 corruption slots across nine industrial e-commerce workflows grounded in real service logs. Across 10 recent LLMs, silent errors roughly halve task success and usually remain unnoticed; recovery remains incomplete even when models question the affected evidence and re-query its producer. Further analysis shows that these errors often alter downstream e-commerce outputs, with category errors and early-stage corruptions causing the greatest damage. Beyond the benchmark, we provide a simple reliability check that increases error detection and producer refetching more than final task success.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究智能体任务中的静默错误：一个看似合理但错误的结果在没有任何显式失败信号的情况下进入执行历史，并在后续步骤中传播。 我们构建了一项任务来衡量智能体能否容忍这种被污染的状态并仍完成原始任务，并提出了 RITE——一个基于真实服务日志、由九个工业级电商工作流中的 167 个污染槽位构建的基准。 在 10 个近期大语言模型上的实验表明，静默错误大约使任务成功率减半，且通常不被察觉；即使模型对受影响的证据提出质疑并向其生产者重新查询，恢复仍不完整。 进一步分析显示，这些错误常常改变下游电商输出，其中类别错误和早期阶段的污染造成的损害最大。 除基准之外，我们还提供了一个简单的可靠性检查方法，它能更多地提升错误检测和生产者重新获取的比例，而对最终任务成功的提升相对有限。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools in four roles. First, the authors wrote the initial draft of every manuscript section, after which AI tools were used to polish the language and improve clarity. Second, AI assisted benchmark construction by helping screen candidate workflows and production-log records (Appendix A ) and by serving as model components during workflow execution. The authors manually reviewed every workflow selected through this process. Third, GLM-5 serves as the automatic judge of task success and observation state, and labels whether a corruption would change the business conclusion (Appendix C ). Fourth, AI assisted with coding. The authors reviewed and validated all AI-assisted code, screening decisions, workflow outputs, and generated benchmark artifacts before use.

paragraphs.en: For each selected workflow, we mapped each candidate production-log record to the required start inputs and executed it on a structure-preserving replica. The corresponding trace was retained with the selected log. For safe trace collection, the replicas retained node identities, graph edges, data references, read-only retrieval, deterministic computation, and model-inference nodes, while writes, reporting calls, locks, memory updates, and external sends were neutralized or guarded.

paragraphs.en: We synthesize 15 papers spanning agent and tool failures, data quality, and factuality. paragraphs.en: The main taxonomy contains two semantic groups and seven leaves (Table 6 ). The first group changes which object or category is referenced; the second preserves the object while changing one of its attributes or values. Each leaf requires a schema-valid value whose task-relevant meaning differs from the recorded value.
paragraphs.zh: 主分类体系包含两个语义组与七个叶子节点（表 6）。 第一组改变所引用的对象或类别；第二组在保留对象的同时改变其某一属性或取值。 每个叶子节点都需要一个符合模式的有效取值，其与任务相关的含义不同于已记录的取值。

sents.en: Each leaf requires a schema-valid value whose task-relevant meaning differs from the recorded value.

paragraphs.en: The injection locus is annotated independently of the semantic leaf and takes one of two values: tool_output , where the substitute is written into the producer observation, or tool_input , where it is written into a downstream tool argument.
paragraphs.zh: 注入位置独立于语义叶子进行标注，取以下两个值之一：tool_output，即替代内容写入生产者观测中；或 tool_input，即替代内容写入下游工具参数中。

paragraphs.en: Tools Fail ( Sun et al., 2024 ) establishes the central operational criterion: a tool output may be schema-valid and wrong without raising an exception. The Tool-Augmented LLM Failure Taxonomy ( Winston and Just, 2025 ) reinforces the distinction between explicit and silent failures. The LLM Hallucination Survey ( Huang et al., 2025 ) and Where LLM Agents Fail ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) further separate entity, context, profile, memory, and parameter errors, motivating value-level interventions while excluding failures that arise only from the agent’s internal reasoning or memory. Other taxonomies delimit the scope from adjacent phenomena: the Multi-Agent Failure Taxonomy ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) covers behavioral and system failures, τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ) emphasizes domain-policy compliance, CRMArena-Pro ( Huang et al., 2026 ) adds confidentiality failures, and Reasoning Error Localization ( Tyen et al., 2024 ) distinguishes recognizing an error from correcting its downstream effects. Together, these sources define silent error as an incorrect intermediate value rather than a planning, collaboration, policy, confidentiality, or reasoning failure.
paragraphs.zh: 《Tools Fail》（Sun 等，2024）确立了核心的操作性判据：工具输出可能符合模式（schema）且内容错误，却不引发任何异常。 《工具增强大语言模型失败分类法》（Winston 和 Just，2025）进一步强化了显式失败与静默失败之间的区分。 《大语言模型幻觉综述》（Huang 等，2025）与《大语言模型智能体在何处失败》（Zhu 等，2025）进一步区分了实体错误、上下文错误、画像错误、记忆错误和参数错误，从而推动了值层面的干预，同时排除了仅源于智能体内部推理或记忆的失败。 其他分类法从相邻现象出发界定了研究范围：多智能体失败分类法（Cemri 等，2025）涵盖行为层面与系统层面的失败，τ \tau -bench（Yao 等，2025）强调领域策略合规性，CRMArena-Pro（Huang 等，2026）增加了机密性失败，而《推理错误定位》（Tyen 等，2024）则区分了识别错误与纠正其下游影响。 综合来看，这些文献将静默错误定义为一种不正确的中间值，而非规划、协作、策略、机密性或推理层面的失败。

sents.zh: 《工具增强大语言模型失败分类法》（Winston 和 Just，2025）进一步强化了显式失败与静默失败之间的区分。

sents.en: The LLM Hallucination Survey ( Huang et al., 2025 ) and Where LLM Agents Fail ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) further separate entity, context, profile, memory, and parameter errors, motivating value-level interventions while excluding failures that arise only from the agent’s internal reasoning or memory.
sents.zh: 《大语言模型幻觉综述》（Huang 等，2025）与《大语言模型智能体在何处失败》（Zhu 等，2025）进一步区分了实体错误、上下文错误、画像错误、记忆错误和参数错误，从而推动了值层面的干预，同时排除了仅源于智能体内部推理或记忆的失败。

sents.en: Other taxonomies delimit the scope from adjacent phenomena: the Multi-Agent Failure Taxonomy ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) covers behavioral and system failures, τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ) emphasizes domain-policy compliance, CRMArena-Pro ( Huang et al., 2026 ) adds confidentiality failures, and Reasoning Error Localization ( Tyen et al., 2024 ) distinguishes recognizing an error from correcting its downstream effects.
sents.zh: 其他分类法从相邻现象出发界定了研究范围：多智能体失败分类法（Cemri 等，2025）涵盖行为层面与系统层面的失败，τ \tau -bench（Yao 等，2025）强调领域策略合规性，CRMArena-Pro（Huang 等，2026）增加了机密性失败，而《推理错误定位》（Tyen 等，2024）则区分了识别错误与纠正其下游影响。

sents.en: Together, these sources define silent error as an incorrect intermediate value rather than a planning, collaboration, policy, confidentiality, or reasoning failure.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些文献将静默错误定义为一种不正确的中间值，而非规划、协作、策略、机密性或推理层面的失败。

paragraphs.en: Data-quality and factuality research supplies the distinctions used to organize the seven leaves. The Dirty Data Taxonomy ( Kim et al., 2003 ) separates category, value, relation, and stale-data errors, supporting category-level substitutions, attribute and numeric changes, and temporal staleness. Faithfulness versus Factuality ( Maynez et al., 2020 ) frames an error as a contradiction with its source evidence, providing a common criterion across all leaves. The taxonomy of Factual Errors in Summarization ( Tang et al., 2023 ) distinguishes entity, attribute, numeric, and temporal errors, which map naturally to entity near-duplicates, profile-attribute drift, numeric-bucket shifts, and temporal staleness.
paragraphs.zh: 数据质量与事实性研究提供了用于组织这七个叶节点的区分标准。 脏数据分类法（Kim 等，2003）区分了类别错误、取值错误、关系错误和过期数据错误，支持类别级替换、属性与数值更改以及时间上的过期。 忠实性与事实性之辨（Maynez 等，2020）将错误界定为与源证据相矛盾的情况，为所有叶节点提供了一个统一判据。 摘要中事实性错误分类法（Tang 等，2023）区分了实体错误、属性错误、数值错误和时间错误，这些错误自然对应于实体近似重复、属性档案漂移、数值分桶偏移以及时间过期。

paragraphs.en: Several sources refine particular boundaries. Butterfly Effects in Toolchains ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) shows how incorrect tool arguments propagate downstream, motivating tool_input as an intervention locus in addition to tool_output . Work on Duplicate Record Detection ( Elmagarmid et al., 2007 ) motivates the distinction between real near-duplicate entities and superficially similar text. FreshLLMs ( Vu et al., 2024 ) grounds temporal staleness in answers that change over time. Finally, LM-Emulated Sandbox Risks ( Ruan et al., 2024 ) helps exclude system and safety failures from the semantic taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 若干文献进一步细化了特定边界。 《工具链中的蝴蝶效应》（Xiong et al., 2025）展示了错误的工具参数如何向下游传播，从而说明除了 tool_output 之外，tool_input 也可作为干预点。 关于《重复记录检测》的研究（Elmagarmid et al., 2007）为区分真正的近似重复实体与表面相似的文本提供了依据。 FreshLLMs（Vu et al., 2024）以随时间变化的答案为基础，刻画了时间上的陈旧性。 最后，《语言模型模拟沙盒风险》（Ruan et al., 2024）有助于从语义分类体系中排除系统故障与安全故障。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the agent and tool literature defines when an error is silent and what lies outside scope, while the data-quality and factuality literature supplies the semantic forms of the corrupted value. We adapt these distinctions into schema-valid, single-slot workflow interventions; the semantic leaf describes what changed, and the locus records where that change enters the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，智能体与工具相关文献界定了何为静默错误以及何种情况超出范围，而数据质量与事实性文献则提供了被污染值的语义形式。 我们将这些区分转化为符合模式（schema）的单槽工作流干预；语义叶子描述发生了什么变化，而位置记录该变化从何处进入轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Execute. The agent follows Eq. 1 for at most 25 steps. At each step, it outputs a thought and a JSON action that either calls a tool with arguments or stops with a final answer. Each condition uses a newly initialized copy of the same workflow-specific tool registry and case-specific replay snapshot. Tool names are normalized through workflow aliases. For each call, E i E_{i} first searches for an argument-matched recorded response and returns it if found; repeated unmatched calls may consume the next unconsumed response in recorded order, while calls absent from or exhausted in the snapshot fall back to the live read-only toolbox. Replay hits, misses, live fallbacks, and observation lengths are recorded for audit.
paragraphs.zh: 执行。 智能体最多按公式 1 执行 25 步。 在每一步中，它输出一个思考和一段 JSON 动作，该动作要么带参数调用工具，要么以最终答案停止。 每个条件都使用同一工作流专用工具注册表和用例专用重放快照的新初始化副本。 工具名称通过工作流别名进行规范化。 对于每次调用，E i E_{i} 首先搜索参数匹配的已记录响应，若找到则返回；重复的未匹配调用可能按记录顺序消耗下一条未消耗的响应，而快照中缺失或已耗尽的调用则回退到实时只读工具箱。 重放命中、未命中、实时回退以及观测长度都会被记录以供审计。

paragraphs.en: Across the ten models, each condition has 1,670 scheduled rollouts; in total, 73 scheduled rollouts produced no valid record. A rollout is excluded if any of its observations contains a tool-execution error message, which indicates an environment-side anomaly; this rule removes 201 rollouts. The retained rollouts number 1,599, 1,575, and 1,562 for the correct, implicit, and explicit conditions. Noticed is computed on all retained rollouts, and RSR on the 1,576, 1,555, and 1,543 retained rollouts that received a result judgment.

paragraphs.en: This appendix reports an independent human validation of two automatically produced evaluation labels: the LLM-based Result judgment that defines RSR and the trajectory-derived Noticed label.

paragraphs.en: We recruited six university participants through a campus forum. The recruitment post described an approximately 50-minute annotation task, and each participant received RMB 50 upon completion. We selected 100 rollouts using stratified sampling: 28 were from the correct condition, 35 from the explicit-error condition, and 37 from the implicit-error condition, with 10 rollouts from each evaluated model. Within each stratum defined by model and condition, rollouts were drawn uniformly at random. Each rollout was independently assigned to three participants, and each participant annotated 50 rollouts, yielding 300 participant–rollout judgments. To balance overlap, each of the 20 possible three-person annotator groups was assigned five rollouts. Participants were instructed to work independently and not discuss individual cases.

paragraphs.en: For each rollout, the interface presented the user task, the correct reference evidence, the complete agent trajectory, any new tool observations, and the final answer. Annotation then proceeded in two stages. In the blind stage, participants answered two binary questions: (i) whether the final answer solved the user task (Result), and (ii) whether the agent explicitly noticed a data anomaly and subsequently invoked a tool to verify it (Noticed). A Noticed label therefore required both an explicit recognition signal in the reasoning and a later verification action. Once submitted, these labels were locked. In the review stage, the interface revealed the two automatic evaluation labels and their rationales. Participants marked each label as agree , disagree , or unsure , with an optional comment. Figure 4 illustrates the two stages. Because the second-stage responses may be influenced by the revealed rationales, we treat the blind-stage comparison as the primary validation and report review-stage agreement only as complementary evidence.

paragraphs.en: For the blind-stage analysis, we used the majority vote of the three independent annotations as the human reference label for each rollout. paragraphs.en: The asymmetric Result errors help explain its lower κ \kappa : the human majority labeled 89/100 rollouts as solved, compared with 69/100 for the result judge, and 22 of the 24 disagreements followed this direction. Inspection of the rationales and comments suggests that participants sometimes accepted broadly responsive answers, whereas the result judge more strictly enforced query-specific completeness and evidence support. This strictness follows the judge’s design: an answer counts as solved only if every task-critical claim is supported by the reference evidence or a new observation, and the same judge and criterion are applied to all three matched conditions. Although human Fleiss’ κ \kappa for Result is 0.477, all three participants agreed on 80/100 rollouts, indicating that disagreement is concentrated in a limited set of borderline cases rather than reflecting widespread annotation instability. paragraphs.en: This appendix presents two baseline case studies, not State Checker interventions. In Case 1, the agent successfully refetches the corrupted producer but later overwrites the recovered evidence during reasoning. Case 2 follows an Unnoticed implicit error from a plausible category substitution to a wrong final recommendation.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录呈现两个基线案例研究，并非 State Checker 的干预案例。 在案例 1 中，智能体成功重新获取了损坏的生产者，但随后在推理过程中覆盖了已恢复的证据。 案例 2 跟踪了一次未被察觉的隐式错误，从一次看似合理的类别替换最终导致了错误的最终推荐。

paragraphs.en: Entries labeled P* summarize inherited prefix events shown to the agent; entries labeled R* are continuation steps generated by the evaluated model. Each step lists the agent action, the observed result, and a diagnostic note. Producer refetch records whether the model re-invokes the producer of the affected value. Observation state describes the latest valid producer observation as Recovered, Residual, or Neither, while final task success separately asks whether the complete answer resolves the user query.
paragraphs.zh: 标记为 P* 的条目总结了呈现给智能体的继承前缀事件；标记为 R* 的条目是由被评估模型生成的后续步骤。 每个步骤都列出了智能体动作、观察到的结果以及一条诊断说明。 Producer refetch（生产者重新获取）记录模型是否重新调用了受影响值的生产者。 Observation state（观察状态）将最新的有效生产者观察描述为 Recovered（已恢复）、Residual（残留）或 Neither（两者皆非），而最终任务成功则单独询问完整答案是否解决了用户查询。

paragraphs.en: The setup box makes the instance, intervention, and expected evidence explicit before presenting the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 设置框在呈现轨迹之前，明确了实例（instance）、干预（intervention）和预期证据（expected evidence）。

paragraphs.en: The decisive error is a reasoning overwrite . The model obtains and initially uses the correct interval, but later treats missing stage annotations as permission to invent a generic boundary. Producer refetch is therefore necessary but insufficient: recovery also requires preserving the authority of corrected evidence over later derived decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 决定性的错误是一次推理覆盖。 模型获取并最初使用了正确的时间区间，但后来却把缺失的阶段标注当作了发明一个通用边界的许可。 因此，生产者的重新获取是必要的但并不充分：恢复还要求保持已修正证据相对于后续派生决策的权威性。

paragraphs.en: The second case shows the complementary failure mode: the model never questions or refetches the affected producer, so the polluted value remains the organizing premise throughout the continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种情况展示了互补的失败模式：模型从不质疑或重新获取受影响的生产者数据，因此被污染的值在整个后续过程中仍然作为组织性前提存在。

paragraphs.en: The important transition occurs in R2. The additional evidence is non-financial, not positively pet-related, but the inherited category has already established a pet hypothesis. The model therefore interprets absence of finance content as confirmation rather than insufficient evidence. This is the propagation pattern targeted by the benchmark: a locally plausible error becomes an organizing premise, shapes later evidence interpretation, and determines the recommended action.
paragraphs.zh: 重要的转变发生在 R2 中。 补充证据是非财务类的，也与宠物没有直接关联，但继承下来的类别已经确立了一个宠物假设。 因此，模型将财务内容的缺失解读为确认，而不是证据不足。 这正是该基准所针对的传播模式：一个局部看似合理的错误成为组织性前提，塑造了后续的证据解读，并决定了所推荐的操作。

paragraphs.en: Several limitations qualify our findings. First, each silent-error instance contains a single corrupted value, and re-querying its producer returns the unpolluted response; RITE therefore measures recovery when a trustworthy verification path is available, and faults that persist across re-queries are left to future work. Second, recorded calls are replayed, whereas valid calls absent from the recordings are served by read-only live tools, so continuations that leave the recorded paths may observe current tool behavior. Third, temporal staleness is defined in the taxonomy but not instantiated. Finally, RSR relies on an LLM judge, whose errors may affect absolute scores.
paragraphs.zh: 若干局限性对我们的发现有所限定。 首先，每个静默错误实例仅包含单个被污染的值，且重新查询其生产者会返回未被污染的响应；因此 RITE 度量的是在存在可信验证路径时的恢复情况，而跨重新查询持续存在的故障则留待未来工作。 其次，被重放的是已录制的调用，而录制中缺失的有效调用由只读的实时工具提供服务，因此偏离已录制路径的后续执行可能观察到当前的工具行为。 第三，时间性陈旧在分类法中已有定义，但未被实例化。 最后，RSR 依赖于一个大语言模型裁判，其错误可能影响绝对分数。
